# 3-Day Singapore Business Trip Plan

A practical 3-day plan for one traveler, centered on transit-friendly lodging, efficient meeting windows, one client dinner, and short evening sightseeing. Budget target: **SGD 1,200 excluding airfare**.

## Trip Itinerary and Cost Plan

### Day 1: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 — Arrival, settle in, first meetings
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Arrive in Singapore; aim for a hotel near **MRT Downtown, East-West, or North-South Line** for easy city access.
- Afternoon: Early check-in or luggage drop; work block for email, prep, and first meeting.
- Evening: Short sightseeing at **Marina Bay promenade** or **Merlion Park**; keep it to 45–60 minutes.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/a/ae/1_singapore_national_day_parade_2011_fireworks.jpg Alt=Evening: Short sightseeing at **Marina Bay promenade** or **Merlion Park**; keep it to 45–60 minutes, Singapore
- Dinner: Simple local dinner near the hotel to stay rested.

### Day 2: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 — Core meetings, client dinner, evening walk
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Main business meetings and calls; schedule the most important session before lunch.
- Afternoon: Buffer for follow-ups, coworking, or a second meeting window.
- Evening: **Client dinner** in the CBD or Marina Bay area, then a short walk along the waterfront.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/79/Gardens_by_the_bay%2C_Marina_bay_sands%2C_CBD_and_Singapore_Flyer%2C_Singapore_%2818426255536%29.jpg Alt=Evening: **Client dinner** in the CBD or Marina Bay area, then a short walk along the waterfront, Singapore
- Dinner: Reserve a quieter restaurant with private or semi-private seating if discussion is needed.

### Day 3: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 — Wrap-up, checkout, departure
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/clock.svg
- Morning: Final meetings, invoice/admin tasks, and checkout prep.
- Afternoon: Checkout, airport transfer, and departure.
- Evening: If time allows before leaving, do a quick stop at **Gardens by the Bay exterior** or a nearby mall/café for a final reset.

### Expense Breakdown
| Category | Planned Spend (SGD) | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Hotel, 2 nights | 420 | Mid-range business hotel near MRT, Wi-Fi included |
| Local transport | 60 | MRT + airport transfers + occasional taxi/ride-hail |
| Meals, non-client | 180 | Breakfasts, lunches, light dinners |
| Client dinner | 180 | Mid-range dinner for one client and one traveler |
| Evening sightseeing | 40 | Entry/snacks/coffee as needed |
| Miscellaneous | 120 | Printing, SIM/data top-up, contingency |
| **Total** | **1,000** | Leaves **~200 SGD** buffer |

## Recommended Hotel Strategy

### Best-fit stay profile
- **Area:** Bugis, City Hall, Tanjong Pagar, or Marina Bay edge
- **Transit:** Direct or one-transfer access to MRT
- **Wi-Fi:** Business-rated or consistently reviewed as reliable
- **Check-in:** Ask for **early check-in** or same-day luggage storage
- **Room choice:** Quiet room, desk space, strong blackout curtains

### Practical booking target
- **Target nightly rate:** SGD 180–260
- **Ideal total for 2 nights:** SGD 360–520
- **Why this works:** Keeps the trip comfortable while preserving budget for meetings and dinner

## Packing Checklist

### Business essentials
- Passport and any entry documents
- Laptop, charger, and phone charger
- Universal adapter
- Presentation files stored offline
- Business cards
- Earbuds/headset for calls

### Clothing
- 2 business outfits
- 1 smart-casual outfit for dinner
- Lightweight jacket or blazer for meeting rooms
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Socks and undergarments for 3 days
- Compact umbrella

### Travel and health
- Reusable water bottle
- Small toiletries kit
- Medications and a basic pain reliever
- Power bank
- Hand sanitizer and tissues
- Card or payment method with foreign transaction support

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Plan MRT Routes] https://www.smrt.com.sg/
Action: [Button: Find Dinner Spots] https://www.chope.co/singapore-restaurants

## Sources

- Singapore tourism overview: https://www.visitsingapore.com/
- MRT network and transit info: https://www.lta.gov.sg/
- Hotel search and neighborhood ideas: https://www.booking.com/city/sg/singapore.html
